title: CommonsDecisionRequest
description: A blocked worker's decision prompt, normalized from a cmux notification (or the emit CLI), ready for coach mediation. Flows from the sense-decision feature to the mediate-decision feature.

blockOption.description: One selectable answer within a choice block.

label.description: Human-readable option text. cmux feed replies select by label.

block.description: One modular unit of a decision document. The block grammar (the composable vocabulary): single_choice (pick one), multi_choice (pick 0..N, alias checkbox, honoring min/max), free_text (type an answer), confirm (approve/deny, alias permission), group (compose child blocks). A decision is a composition of blocks, NOT a fixed Claude question shape; this is the agent-agnostic contract grammar.

block_id.description: Stable id of this block within the document; for a cmux question this is the question id. The answer routes back per block_id.

kind.description: The block kind. multi_choice covers checkbox/multi-select; confirm covers permission/approve-deny.

header.description: Optional short header/label for the block (cmux question header).

min_selections.description: For multi_choice: minimum number of options that must be selected.

max_selections.description: For multi_choice: maximum number of options that may be selected.

operations.description: Append a commons:decision:request entry to the decision stream

request_id.description: Stable identifier for this decision request (uuid).

worker.description: The blocked worker agent the prompt was read from.

surface_id.description: cmux surface ref the worker runs in (e.g. surface:3).

run_id.description: ATDD run id owning the worker, when known.

agent_handle_ref.description: Opaque agent-control handle ref for delivery.

prompt.description: The structured decision extracted from the worker surface text.

raw_text.description: Raw (ANSI-stripped) tail of the surface the prompt was extracted from.

question.description: The decision question presented to the worker.

options.description: The selectable options. Empty is not a valid decision request.

document.description: The full modular decision composition: every block preserved (multi-question + checkbox/multi_select), NOT flattened to the first question. When present, this is the canonical decision the coach/decider answers; the flat `prompt` above is a single-block convenience mirror of the first block for back-compat. Optional so single-question entry paths (sense/emit) need not populate it.

blocks.description: The ordered blocks of the decision document. Empty is not a valid document.

provenance.description: How this request entered the bridge. notify-hook and emit-CLI MUST serialize identically except for source.

notification_hash.description: Hash of the originating cmux notification payload, when source=cmux_notification.
